EXPOSED: Is This The Worst Political Psy-Op In Modern History? | Ep. 1767

piped.video/watch?v=6lywS-…

I’ve done entire shows making fun of Australia for being woke. I’ve never said anything about the positive aspects of Australian society. And yet guys like Noah have never called me out for that. It’s only a problem when I treat Israel the exact same way I treat every other foreign country.

I criticize gay pride stuff in my own country all the time. I criticize it in Canada. Australia. The UK. Countless times over the years. You’re fine with that but you don’t want me to ever object to it in Israel. I’m not the one who’s making Israel a special exception. You are.


Noah Pollak (@NoahPollak)

Israel is an ideal society judged by the things Walsh claims to care about -- it is religious, patriotic, manly, traditional, extraordinarily family-centric, and has the highest fertility rate

This gives me new respect for Jussie Smollett. He bootstrapped his fake hate crime and paid for it himself rather than having SPLC organize and fund it for him. Support your local mom and pop hate crime hoax operations before they’re all put out of business by the big guys.

The excuse offered by the left is that the SPLC was merely paying informants as part of their investigations into “hate groups.” This is bullshit of course but it also goes to show how groups like SPLC have operated as quasi government agencies despite having no legal authority to do so. We have been living under the tyranny not just of unelected judges and bureaucrats but also unelected activist organizations.

Others are pointing out that “General Hate” might be my rank, which would put me above Major Hate and Lieutenant Colonel Hate. In which case I rescind my complaint and gladly accept this prestigious title.
Also offended that I was relegated to the “general hate” category. I feel my hate is much more specific and specialized.
SPLC has a whole section of their website devoted to me and yet they never offered me any money as part of their scheme. I’m starting to feel a bit offended.

The SPLC is a criminal organization that funded “right wing hate groups” and organized fake right wing protests so that it could then turn around and fundraise off of them and use them as a pretext to crackdown on conservatives nationwide. Keep in mind that every leftist activist group is just as corrupt, dishonest, and sinister as this. SPLC is the tip of the iceberg.

Absolutely evil and disgusting


Israel ישראל (@Israel)

Pride rises at the lowest place on earth 🌈  This June the Dead Sea becomes Pride Land, the biggest LGBTQ+ festival ever in the Middle East. Four days of nonstop celebration community and connection.  

Israel celebrates its LGBTQ+ community bigger than ever 💙





— https://nitter.net/Israel/status/2046166997566976275#m

If you want to have a contest over which one of us has done more to effectively advance the conservative cause and registered real wins both culturally and politically, we can do that. You won’t win. A better path for you is to demonstrate a modicum of humility. You were wrong in your fundamental worldview, which is why you were a leftist. You still retain that fundamental worldview, which is why you think it’s okay for gay men to purchase babies — a view so radically far left that even Democrat

If you were a member of the radical left and by your own admission wrong about everything until very recently, then consider the possibility that you may also be wrong about this. And for the same reason that you were wrong about all of those other things.
*Tenets, damn it
Leave your phone at home
